items.title_zh: 中央邦女县长戴墨镜唱宝莱坞情歌《德里女友》，视频走红
items.summary_en:
Sheopur Collector Sheela Dahima’s pop singer avatar is winning attention on social media. In a viral video, the 2015-batch IAS officer is seen wearing sunglasses and singing ‘Delhi Wali Girlfriend’ from the Bollywood film Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani.

The video surfaced on November 19. However, Dahima clarified that it was recorded two to three years ago. She also said that music has been a part of her life since childhood and that she continues to enjoy singing and practising it. This is not the first time her musical side has caught attention; a video of her singing ‘Leke Pehla Pehla Pyar’ had also surfaced last month.

#SheelaDahima #SheopurCollector #MadhyaPradesh #IASOfficer #BollywoodSongs #IndiaTodaySocial
items.summary_zh: 中央邦舍奥布尔县县长、2015届IAS官员希拉·达希玛戴着墨镜演唱电影《Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani》里的《Delhi Wali Girlfriend》，视频11月19日流出后走红。她澄清视频是两三年前录的，说音乐从小就是生活的一部分；上个月她唱《Leke Pehla Pehla Pyar》的视频也曾流传。评论有人说只要下班后唱就无妨，议员还能上电视、拍电影呢。

items.title_zh: 中央邦小伙站在行驶中的汽车车顶喝酒，视频走红后被捕
items.summary_en:
A 25-year-old man, identified as Mukesh Tanwar, was arrested by Rajgarh police after a video showed him standing atop a moving Hyundai Aura car and drinking on NH-52 in Madhya Pradesh. Police took suo motu cognisance of the viral video, registered a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Motor Vehicles Act, and seized the car used in the stunt.

#Rajgarh #MadhyaPradesh #ViralVideo #HighwayStunt #RoadSafety
items.summary_zh: 中央邦拉杰加尔，25岁男子穆凯什·坦瓦尔被拍到在52号国道上站在一辆行驶中的现代Aura轿车车顶喝酒。警方根据走红视频主动立案，按《印度公正法典》（BNS）和《机动车法》起诉，并扣押了表演用的汽车。

A bizarre scene unfolded at PG College in Barmer, Rajasthan, during the counting of votes for the panchayat elections. While votes were being counted, an employee deployed for duty at the Dungaron Ka Tala Panchayat Samiti counting centre was caught playing a card game on a computer.

#Rajasthan #Barmer #PanchayatElections #ElectionCounting #ViralVideo

items.title_zh: 印度E20乙醇汽油目标达成：平均掺混19.99%，玉米成最大原料
items.summary_en:
INDIA ACHIEVES 20% ETHANOL BLENDING — BUT MAIZE IS EMERGING AS THE BIGGEST WINNER!

India has effectively achieved its 20% ethanol blending target in ESY 2025-26, with grain-based feedstocks accounting for a massive 73.52% of total ethanol supplies. This marks a major structural shift in India's ethanol industry, with significant implications for maize, rice and the sugar sector.

KEY NUMBERS — ESY 2025-26:

• Average ethanol blending: 19.99%.
• Total ethanol blended: 1,134.36 crore litres.
• Ethanol requirement: 1,050 crore litres.
• Ethanol allocated: 1,196.90 crore litres.
• Actual ethanol supplies: 1,088.91 crore litres.

GRAIN vs SUGAR: A MAJOR SHIFT

Grain-based ethanol:
• Total: 800.53 crore litres.
• Share: 73.52%.

Sugar-based ethanol:
• Total: 288.38 crore litres.
• Share: 26.48%.

MAIZE DOMINATES GRAIN-BASED ETHANOL

• Maize: 489.71 crore litres — approximately 45% of total ethanol supplies.
• Surplus FCI rice: 233.95 crore litres.
• Damaged foodgrains: 76.87 crore litres.

SUGAR SECTOR CONTRIBUTION

• Sugarcane juice: 153.36 crore litres.
• B-Heavy molasses: 118.04 crore litres.
• C-Heavy molasses: 16.98 crore litres.

Approximately 32.45 lakh tonnes of sugar were diverted towards ethanol production:
• Sugarcane juice: 23 lakh tonnes.
• B-Heavy molasses: 9.44 lakh tonnes.

THE BIG AGRICULTURAL MARKET IMPLICATION:

Maize has become the single largest feedstock in India's ethanol programme, supplying nearly 46% of total ethanol supplies according to AIDA.

This has important consequences:

1. MAIZE: Structural demand from distilleries is strengthening its industrial consumption base and increasing competition between ethanol, poultry and starch industries.

2. RICE: FCI surplus rice continues to provide an alternative feedstock, but maize remains the dominant grain-based source.

3. SUGAR: Sugar diversion of 32.45 lakh tonnes remains significant, although sugar-based ethanol now accounts for only 26.48% of supplies.

4. DISTILLERIES: Feedstock diversification has become central to India's energy security strategy.

MY TAKEAWAY:

India's ethanol programme is no longer just a sugar-industry story. It has increasingly become a maize-demand story.

With grain-based feedstocks supplying nearly three-fourths of ethanol, maize availability, prices and competition from the poultry sector will become increasingly important variables for India's agricultural balance sheet.
items.summary_zh: 帖子援引印度酿酒协会（AIDA）数据称，印度在2025-26乙醇供应年实际完成20%乙醇掺混目标：平均掺混率19.99%，共掺混1134.36克若尔升，需求量为1050克若尔升。粮食类原料占乙醇供应的73.52%，其中玉米489.71克若尔升，约占总供应的45%，成为最大单一原料；糖类原料仅占26.48%，约324.5万吨（原文32.45拉克吨）的糖被转去生产乙醇。作者认为这会加剧乙醇、家禽饲料和淀粉行业对玉米的争夺。
